Boys of Avix #4

Keep Me Never

Meagan Brandy

3.97
12,294 ratings1,187 reviews
Rate this book
On the outside, it looks like I've got it all together. I'm killing it on the football field, pushing harder than ever before and breaking league records.

But on the inside, I'm drowning and there's no one to pull me up.

Until her.

I tried to stay away, to keep my distance so I wouldn't ruin us both, but I was powerless against her.

She's everything I didn't know I wanted and more than I could ever deserve.

Just when I think maybe I'm becoming the man I want to be, my world comes crashing down around me, and I'm faced with a choice that has the power to break us both.

Suddenly, I'm right back where I started. I'm the guy with nothing to give―and she's the girl who deserves the world.

Book one: Devastatingly emotional 😭
Book two: Somber and healing ❤️‍🩹
Book three: Fun and flirty 🤩

…Book four: GROUNDING. Life-affirming. Redemption. 😌

Meagan just keeps on surprising me! Despite having loved the series so far, I went into this book with low expectations. Why? I have disliked Chase throughout the whole series yet somehow Meagan had me rooting for him within the first few chapters. Somehow she completely changed my opinion of this man. I got to see behind the mask. All his insecurities and the heavy burden he has been carrying 😮‍💨 I was wrong to judge him by his actions before knowing what he was going through. And Paige totally grounded the whole story right from the word go. Throw in some financial/family politics and you have a totally captivating finale 🙌🏽

“Maybe this girl, this kindhearted, gorgeous girl, is the exception. The one good thing I’m allowed without the universe’s retaliation. Maybe, I no longer have to brace for a hit to come. Maybe I really can keep the girl and the game." 💖

Killing it on the football field, breaking league records. Chase is not a man to be messed with, yet ironically, on the inside, he is a mess. With pressure on all sides, he is drowning. Until she enters his life, breathing air into his lungs. But faced with a choice that has the power to break them both, he must make a life-changing decision…home is where she is - can he ever find his way back home?

"When I’m with her, my mind doesn’t race with a million thoughts I can’t even make out. There is no pressure or fear. Only calm that settles like fresh mountain air, allowing me to just…breathe. She is my air." 😌

Gosh 😅 Chase deals with SO much in this book. Between family drama, financial stress, and expectations on the field, he has no let up. The major thing I noticed about him in this book was the incredible depth of character development. At the beginning, he is a complete mess, frustrated, head spinning, and spiralling, however, by the end (thanks mostly to Paige), he is so much more grounded and sure of himself and his decisions. He goes through a lot to get there but I was genuinely moved by his final few chapters 🥲

Paige was a truly incredible character! Her unwavering belief in others, her kindness, her heart…she was a ray of sunshine, grounding and enlightening Chase’s day. She was able to see what truly matters in life and radiated love, understanding that love doesn’t just heal, it empowers. She was not only what Chase needed, but what the series as a whole needed. Her backstory brought another whole dimension to the story, making it so much more than a simple romance novel. It brought the depth of family legacy alongside unexpected twists and turns. I will say it again: excellently executed plot 👏🏽

"It’s a quiet pull, a sort of anchoring place I never expected to find. Warm and inviting, the kind of place a man could rest. Stay—maybe even belong." ⚓️ 💖 ✨

The romance was SO well done. I am honestly still shocked at how much it affected me. I FELT every heartbreaking moment, every scene tugging on my heart in a different way. Chase had so many obstacles to overcome, but seeing Paige stick by him through these moments as a grounding force was so life-affirming. Their connection felt like one of the deepest in the series. There was no question that these two were meant to be together despite the eternal threats.

“Freedom is the soul’s journey, where love transcends time and space. I will always love you, no matter the distance. I will always be yours, no matter the lifetime. Love, like a butterfly, always finds its way home. You are my home, Angel.” 🦋✨

I am so sad to have come to the end of this series. As a whole, I was surprised to have enjoyed it as much. It was the series I didn’t know I needed and will remain with me. MB did a wonderful job of bringing the whole cast back together in this finale. I feel like I’ve watched them all grow up from wild teens to admirable young adults. And the epilogue 😭 so beautiful 🤐

Overall, this was an incredibly compelling and satisfying end to a wonderful series 😌

"And as I look out across my friends, I can feel it. The weight I didn’t even know I was carrying lifting off me, the love of my friends settling over me. This is exactly where I’m supposed to be. I’m going to keep this feeling with me. And if anyone ever asks me if I feel like I’m missing, I know exactly what the answer will remain: Never." 🥰 ❤️ 👋🏼

4.5 🌟🌟🌟🌟✨

“But she’s right here, looking at me like I’m something worth holding on to.”

Oh my heart! Oh my soul! I don’t know if any words I write will do this love story or series justice. To even say that Keep Me Never is emotionally stunning and superbly written isn’t even enough. It was more than I expected. Perfectly imperfect.

Keep Me Never is the heart-thrashing tale of a tarnished football star hero and a heroine re-growing her wings to fly, two souls tethered together as they break and burn. Broken sees broken. Like sees like. Real sees real. And Chase? I broke so hard for him.

Prepare to fall hard for Chase and his redemption story. This romance seriously gave me SayYou Swear vibes and feels! All the feels! The chemistry and undeniable, soul-deep connection? Magical!!! My heart shattered and soared these soulmates who find salvation in each other.

“Let me ruin you.”

Keep Me Never is so much more than a sports romance. It’s a journey of rising after falling. It’s the realization that’s it’s okay not to be okay. It’s the value of friends, family, and friends who are family.

This love story is an epic, unforgettable, and meaningful masterpiece that swallows the heart and soul. It’s shattering …. It’s stunning … it’s intense … it’s everything. I felt this book in my bones, stealing my heart and tears, becoming a part of me. Keep Me Never? No … keep me forever.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ heartbreakingly beautiful stars but worth the entire universe

I binged the heck out of this book. I’ve been so excited for Chase to get his HEA. It’s been years in the making! I knew Meagan was going to put us through it and pair him with the perfect FMC, and honestly, this book exceeded my expectations. Chase’s HEA was everything we all needed. If you’ve been following this series from the beginning like I have, you know exactly what I’m talking about! It was an honor to get to read this book early, and I will forever cherish this series. Each book has stolen my heart in its own way.

Chase feeling unworthy of the world and the love he had around him will never not gut me. The remorse this man felt after everything he put Ari through was sooo thick! Throughout the series, you learn to love this beautiful man’s heart more and more, but I never expected this kind of redemption arc. It was so much more than I imagined. Chase has one of the biggest hearts of any MMC I’ve ever read about, and he continuously takes care of the people around him while handling life changing heartache. It was all just so beautifully done. And pairing him with an FMC like Paige couldn’t have been executed better.

We meet Paige early on in the series as Noah’s best friend, but to see her end up with Chase was incredibly well planned on Meagan’s part. She was absolutely adorable and the little ray of sunshine Chase needed, his very own Certified Negativity Exorcist. She became his touchstone, and I just loved watching the friendship they shared become so much more.

I will forever be in love with the way Meagan is ending this series. Chase’s book was 100% worth the wait, and I can’t wait for more books from her. She truly is such a beautiful writer and creates MCs with the biggest hearts.

🎧 Audiobook Review 🎧
Dual narration
Narrated by Lily Drake and Chase Brown

I actually eyeball read this book, but when I realized who the narrators were, I knew I had to listen right away! I just love these two narrators together. They were the perfect cast to bring this beautiful book to life. I fell in love with Chase Brown’s narration for the first time in Promise Me Not, and I was so excited to see him return for this series. He did such a wonderful job bringing out the best parts of Chase. Every strong emotion, the love he felt for Paige, and the quiet heartache he carried. It was a beautiful performance and exactly what we needed for Chase.

And my gosh, did he nail this dirty-talking MMC! “Stay still.” YES, SIR.

Lily Drake is a longtime favorite! Her beautiful voice was perfect as Paige. I was so happy to see her cast for this book and knew she’d do an incredible job bringing Paige to life in the sweetest, sunshiny way and she absolutely did. I can’t recommend this audiobook enough. It was so well done!

Even from when I finished 'Trust Me Always' I wanted for Chase to have his happy ending too. He has gone through so many heartbreaking moments, which slowly changed him and made him feel like an outsider in his own group of friends, because of the betrayal he was part of in the past. Now, he wasn't in the best place yet, but one girl has definitely creeped into his heart and started to break his walls, little by little. Paige was the ray of sunshine which enlightened Chase's days and made them bearable. But can Chase get over the mistakes he's made and accept that he deserves happiness? Can he be considered good enough for sweet Paige??

Ohhh, this story affected me so, so much!! I felt those raw, heartbreaking emotions into my bones. It had such opposite sides, because at one moment you felt like crying, then you couldn't happier because of how things were. Chase definitely didn't have the easiest way into reaching his happiness, always being something which made things harder for him. I was elated to see him with a smile on his face when he was in Paige's presence, making my heart squeeze so hard.🥹 I adoored their connection and how beautifully things have shifted between them and how sweet their connection was. They completed each other so well and I hated that there were some outside things that threatened their happiness.

It was sooo worth the wait for this book, glad that I could finally have this closure for Chase after everything he's been put through in the other previous books. He already had a part of my heart even from 'Say you swear', being heartbroken because of all the pain he had to endure and I needed to have this closure for him. I loved this whole series, falling in love with each character present in them!🩷

“Love, like a butterfly, always finds it’s way home”

When I first started The Boys of Avix and first met Chase in Say You Swear, I never thought I’d end up here. But I am so insanely happy that I have. Chase’s redemption arc was beautiful, emotional, and deeply touching. My heart broke for this guy over and over. Meagan Brandy was right, I LOVE Chase.

Paige is the perfect person for Chase. Their friendship was what they both needed. They liked and supported each other, talked to each other and understood each other before anything romantic happened. Their foundation was solid, and reading how their love story blossomed was such a joy. They both give to each other what the other needs. They heal each others broken parts and they both love very selflessly.

Poor Chase goes through A LOT. Your heart will break for him over and over again but it WILL mend in the end. But this was an emotional ride. I got sucker punched several times and worked so hard not to but I always ended up crying. Chase is a broken wounded man who thinks so negatively about himself that he doesn’t see his own worth. Sadly life keeps playing into those negative thought patterns and the boy TRIES so hard, so many times. This guy is a FIGHTER. Everything with school, his family, football, and his inability to forgive himself for his mistakes were so painful to read. But it was beautiful seeing him keep getting back up, keep fighting, and love selflessly even when he didn’t make the best choices, his heart was always in the right place. He loved SO hard that it made him sacrifice himself time and again for the people he loves.

Paige is a gorgeous character with such a pure beautiful soul. She lives selflessly and always wants to help others and wants to live up to all her dad wanted for her. Her motivation for all her choices is always based in love. She is the perfect personality to put the pieces of Chase’s heart back together. She understands him, knows him so well, protects him, and heals him. I loved her open heart for everyone, how her biggest dreams involved helping others and I adored how she honored her dad and how he influenced her.

I loved the end of this book. I love how we get a glimpse into the future and I cried so many happy tears. I’m so sad this has now completed this series I adore them so much. I miss them all already but I couldn’t be happier with where they all end up. This perfect found family that loves so fiercely. They will all stay with me. Thank you Meagan for so many emotions, so much joy, and these stunning characters.

Oh my goodness, where do I even begin? 

Keep Me Never is the final book in the Avix series - and while it isn't 100% necessary to read all of the books before it - I HIGHLY recommend it so you get the full effects of not just Chase's story but if all the side characters as well. 

On the outside it looks like Chase has it all - but on the inside he's a mess. A betrayal from someone he's trusted weighs heavily on him, and he is barely keeping it together - until her. He's tried to stay away, keep his distance because Chase doesn't have anything to give,, but she deserves the world. 

Just when Chase thinks he's becoming the man who he wants to be, he is met with an impossible choice that sends his world crashing around him, putting him right back to where he started. 

So if you didn't already know, I have been DYING for Chase's book since SYS first dropped a handful of years ago. I wanted to see what went on inside Chase's head and I -finally- got my wish. This book was bittersweet and I absolutely adored it. Chase's story finishing off the Avix series & it was... I have no words. Chase's story was more than I could have ever expected & the whole gang together brought the feeling of rightness, a feeling of home. And the story made me feel all the things. It was cute and sweet. And had me kicking my feet in giddiness one minute, and an emotional wreck the next. I swooned, I cried, I gasped & I didn't want it to ever end - not just Chase's story but finishing off the series of characters I fell in love with. 5⭐ out of 5⭐
